mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the clinic history with depot intake was most worthwhile: it showed exactly how the filter produced a misleading zero.

leastWorthwhile.text: Clearing the printer was straightforward but less engaging than examining what the records meant.

surprise.text: The depot's zero meant no requests were admitted to its count, not that nobody needed anything.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary, though several later choices were the only offered combination.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see whether Moth's correction and the community's evidence can change the directory, although the mostly forced sequence offered limited decisions.
